channel_intelligence.state_of_channel: 84 days in: 172 public videos, 6,684 lifetime views, 23 subscribers (+1), 172 lifetime watch hours. Headline numbers look healthy - 464 views (+12%), 3.3 watch hours (+8%) - but they are entirely Shorts: 450 of 464 views. The first Studio CTR read ever shows why watch time is flat while views grow: long-form got 207 thumbnail impressions in 7 days at 1.5% CTR for 14 views and a 1:09 average view duration. The 7 longs published since Aug 24 have 10 lifetime views combined; July longs did 30-87 each. RELATED_VIDEO traffic, which delivered 100 watch minutes the prior week, delivered 0 this week. The single most important thing: long-form distribution has switched off, and long-form is the only format that produces watch hours. Matched 5-day API windows show watch minutes 543 -> 161 -> 32 across three weeks while views held ~300.
what_works: Weekend and Friday reels, third straight week: since Aug 17, Fri median 31.5 (n=8), Sat 27.5 (n=8), Sun 18 (n=8) versus Mon 9 (n=13) and Thu 9 (n=14). A 2-3.5x median edge that has now survived three independent weekly samples - the only reel pattern on the channel that has.
Shorts reach is the one thing still compounding: 450 Shorts views this week (+13%), Shorts feed 233 of 292 API views, 14 reels in 7 days delivered on schedule with 41/42 platform posts published.

Fun Bossa remains the watch-time style: 839 lifetime minutes per long (n=3) vs Soft Bossa July batch 557 (n=10) vs Soft Jazz Real Guitar 210 (n=3) vs Soft Bossa autumn uploads 11 (n=7). Still zero Fun Bossa in the pipeline.

Search is the only long-form source that shows intent: YT_SEARCH 28.6% of long-form views in Studio, and 'slow bossa nova', 'soft bossa nova', 'slow morning music', 'bossa nova cafe' are the 28-day queries that land on longs. Title the next longs with those exact phrases.
next_moves: DIAGNOSE THE LONG-FORM COLLAPSE BEFORE UPLOADING MORE. 7 autumn Soft Bossa longs, 10 views total, 1.5% CTR on 207 impressions. Same style and runtime as July longs that did 30-87 views. Two candidate causes, both checkable in Studio this week: (a) the Aug 10 autumn retitle/re-thumb changed what YouTube tests them against; (b) the 1:17:43 identical-runtime uploads are being flagged as duplicates. Open Studio > Content > Videos > Reach for the Sep 3 and Sep 10 longs and read impressions by source. Do not schedule the Sep 17 long until this is answered.

REBUILD THUMBNAILS ON THE 7 DEAD LONGS USING T5 TYPEWRITER-SERIF AND RETITLE TO SEARCH PHRASES. 1.5% CTR is the floor of YouTube's 2-10% small-channel range. T5 beat T3 2.4x on watch minutes in the Aug 24 A/B. Retitle to the queries that actually convert: 'Slow Bossa Nova Cafe', 'Soft Bossa Nova Morning'. Cheapest possible test on videos that currently earn nothing.

STOP OPTIMISING CAPTIONS. 'A minute of calm' went median 115 -> 10; 'cafe sound you didn't know you needed' went 10 -> 35 on Indonesian meme search traffic. Caption medians flip 10x week to week on n=7. Freeze the rotation and redirect that effort to the first 2 seconds of the clip - Studio shows 82.3% of Shorts viewers swipe away.

MOVE MON/THU REEL SLOTS TO FRI/SAT/SUN. Stated Aug 24, not done - the Zernio schedule still runs 2/day flat. Weekend median 18-31.5 vs Mon/Thu 9. Set post_weekly.py to 3/day Fri-Sun and 1/day Mon+Thu at the same 14/week total.

PULL THE 36 SCHEDULED PIPELINE SHORTS. Last 6 published: 0,1,0,1,2,1 views. They also compete with reels in the Shorts tab and dilute the channel's Shorts signal. Recommended Aug 17 and Aug 24; now on the strongest evidence yet.
REFRAME YPP: Jan 31 2027 needs 192 hrs/week vs 3.3 delivered, with long-form at 0 min/week. Plan for the 2027 8,000-hour bar and judge every long on watch minutes only.

channel_intelligence.suno_rules: Data-backed prompt rules, updated 2026-09-14: (1) ALWAYS 'instrumental / no vocals'. (2) KEEP ENERGY CONSISTENT, no dynamic spikes - suggested-video sessions are the watch-time source and they end the moment a track jumps. (3) WRITE 150-MINUTE SETS - longs are 89.8% of lifetime watch time; the top long (1:39) banked 1,819 minutes. (4) FUN/UPBEAT OVER SOFT/SLEEPY ON WATCH MINUTES - 839 vs 557 per long; score styles on minutes, never views. (5) AVOID SOFT JAZZ REAL GUITAR - 210 min/long, 6.7x below Fun Bossa. (6) NAME THE ACTION AND MATCH SEARCH - the 28-day queries that reach longs are 'slow bossa nova', 'soft bossa nova', 'slow morning music', 'bossa nova cafe'; put 'slow' or 'soft' + 'bossa nova' + 'morning/cafe' in the title and the prompt. (7) NEW - DO NOT REUSE RUNTIMES. Seven identical 1:17:43 uploads got 10 views combined; vary set length (120/150/180) so each upload is unmistakably a new asset. (8) WITHDRAWN - the Aug 24 'promise time and feeling' caption rule. Caption medians flipped 10x on the next sample; captions are not a lever.
